name: Haryana: Bhavantar Bharpayee Yojana (Price-Fall Compensation)
summary: Haryana compensates registered vegetable growers when the market price of their crop falls below a government-fixed safe price.

benefits.headline: Compensation when vegetable prices fall below the notified safe price
details: Covers vegetable crops including tomato, potato, onion and cauliflower; the crop list is set by the state.
The state pays the shortfall between the notified price and the market price, with the per-quintal rates and limits set each season. Confirm the current figures with your Horticulture office.

steps: Register your crop and area on the Haryana 'Meri Fasal Mera Byora' portal within the notified period.
Sell your produce at a notified mandi and keep the sale receipt.
The department checks the registered area and the recorded sale prices.
If prices were below the notified safe price, compensation is credited to your bank account.

deadline.text: Registration and sale windows are notified each season. Register before you sow.

caveats: The per-quintal compensation rates were revised over time. Rates quoted elsewhere may be out of date, so confirm with the department.
